changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE payment_transaction ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, policy_id UUID NULL, claim_id UUID NULL, payer_user_id UUID NULL, amount DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL, currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, type VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, provider VARCHAR(80) NULL, provider_reference VARCHAR(160) NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL );
CREATE TABLE payment_event_log ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, payment_transaction_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES payment_transaction(id), event_type VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL );
